subject: Re: The quantity of traffic

body:
There definetly is more traffic now than when I started the game. My impression is that races get more difficult as you progress through the game beacuse of:

  1. Faster and smarter AI
  2. Your cars gets faster and takes more skill to handle (this will get easier over time)
  3. More traffic
